newsitem.title: USA: Washington gunshot victim killed in ambulance.
newsitem.headline: Washington gunshot victim killed in ambulance.

text.p: A gunshot victim was shot again and killed in the ambulance taking him to a hospital Monday night, Washington police said.
Police said an ambulance from the fire department picked up the victim after he was found shot inside a car. The ambulance stopped a few blocks away so medical technicians could stabilise the man.

As he was being treated, a man opened the ambulance door and begain firing, hiting the victim and a paramedic. The gunman was disarmed after a struggle with the ambulance crew and fled with another man, the police said.
The 22-year-old victim was pronounced dead at D.C. General Hospital. The paramedic who was shot in the ankle and another member of the ambulance crew hurt in the struggle were treated and released.
Police said they were looking for the gunman and his accomplice.
In a similar incident a month ago, a gunman pursued his victim to another Washington hospital and killed him there, also wounding a nurse.
